system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature, [Artistic Branch]

Your charges are like a composition of a beautiful symphony, an amazing sculpture, a once in a lifetime painting. Detonating them bring forth the beauty within that others just don’t understand. You gain the second nature release you didn’t select from Explosion Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Lightning or Earth Release keywords, you can change the damage type to force.

You learn three Payloads, and choose which two you have prepared after each rest. Unless a payload says otherwise, affected creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. You learn 2 more Payloads at 11th level and can prepare three to use after each rest.

When you detonate Primed creatures, objects and structures you can select one Payload infusing their effect into the detonation itself. Only one detonation will have the Payload effect.

A1 Scatter burst

Scatter Burst. The detonation forces all creatures who failed their saving throw to be thrown 30-feet into a direction of your choice excluding airborne and falling prone. You can choose which direction each creature is thrown individually.

A2 Smoke Petals

Smoke Petals. The detonation creates a 20-foot radius of smoke that heavily obscures vision. This smoke lasts until the end of your next turn. Creatures who fail their saving throw gain 1 rank of Concussed and Dazzled.

A3 Seismic Quake

Seismic Quake. The detonation shatters the ground making the affected area difficult terrain. Creatures that fail their saving throw are Slowed until the end of their next turn from the shock of the explosion

A4 Fractal Adhesive

Fractal Adhesive. The detonation creates a splash of sticky mud like adhesive that binds to everything. Creatures that fail their saving throw are Restrained in place by the adhesive until the end of their next turn.

A5 Cluster Gallery

Cluster Gallery. The detonation creates 4 mini charges which each land on a point of your choice within 20-feet of the triggering explosions affected area. Each mini charge then explodes in a 5-foot radius forcing creatures in each new zone to make their saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Concussed and being knocked Prone on a failed save. A creature can be affected by up to 2 mini charge at a time, but only make a saving throw once to determine if you suffer the mini charges effect twice.
